gloss: a glance; at first sight; public eye

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
{一目|ひとめ}⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{気|き}に{入|い}った→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧。
examples.english: I liked it the moment I saw it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一目|ひとめ}{惚|ぼ}れ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I fell in love with her at first sight.

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧。
examples.english: To care about what people think.

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: We met out of the public eye.

examples.japanese: {一目|ひとめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧にくい。
examples.english: It's hard to talk in a place where people might see us.

notes:
{一目|ひとめ} has three main uses: a brief look, instant recognition, and being seen by others.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as いちもく in the compound {一目|いちもく}{瞭然|りょうぜん} (perfectly clear at a glance).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一目|ひとめ}{惚|ぼ}れ: love at first sight
- {一目|ひとめ}⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to hold someone in respect/esteem
- {一目|ひとめ}{散|さん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee at full speed
- {一目|ひとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to understand at a glance
- {一目|ひとめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧: to worry about what people think
- {一目|ひとめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid public attention

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一目|ひとめ}: one glance (brief, instant)
- ⟦{一見|いっけん}→一見：17699_ikken⟧: at first glance / apparently (implies a superficial impression that may be wrong)
